acceleration.description: Acceleration level. 'regular' enables MagCache step-skipping for faster generation at a small quality cost; 'none' (default) runs the full denoising schedule.
acceleration.title: Acceleration

enable_prompt_expansion.description: Rewrite the prompt with an LLM before generation. The model is tuned on enhanced prompts; off by default.
enable_prompt_expansion.title: Enable Prompt Expansion

max_image_size.description: Long-edge size (px). Sets the output size for generation tasks and caps source/reference media for editing tasks.
max_image_size.title: Max Image Size

negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt. Defaults to the standard Wan2.2 negative prompt.
negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt

num_frames.description: Number of frames. Snapped internally to 4k+1.
num_frames.title: Num Frames

examples: A cute corgi leaping in a sunny park, Van Gogh oil-painting style.
prompt.title: Prompt

seed.description: Seed for reproducibility. Random when omitted.
seed.title: Seed

actual_prompt.description: The final prompt after expansion (set only when prompt expansion ran).
actual_prompt.title: Actual Prompt

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url
